name: code_read_file
description: Read one file of Ledgerline's code by its path relative to the repository root, exactly as code_search prints it, case and extension included. Use it after a search points at a file. The result is the file's text after one line naming the path and its length. An empty file comes back with that line and nothing after it; it never means the path was wrong. A path that does not exist is an error naming the closest paths that do, so fix the path and call again. Responses are capped: concise returns at most the first 8,000 characters, detailed at most 20,000, and a cut file says where it was cut.

path.description: The file's path relative to the repository root, such as src/util/money.ts, copied from a search result. src/report.ts and src/Report.ts are different files.

response_format.description: concise costs least: the first 8,000 characters, enough for almost every file here. Choose detailed (up to 20,000) only when a concise read was cut before the part you need.

examples.note: the typical call: a path exactly as the search printed it
a hard case: a .tsx file, extension and case exactly as printed, and detailed because the concise read was cut
